winefoxs_spellbooks.configuration.title: Winefox's Spellbooks Configuration
config.winefoxs_spellbooks.max_spell_ran: How far a maid searches for hostile targets. Anything beyond this is never picked. Larger values cost more scanning each tick.
config.winefoxs_spellbooks.start_spell_r: A maid closes to this distance before it starts casting. Individual spells can override it under Spell Compatibles.
config.winefoxs_spellbooks.max_mana_mult: Maximum mana multiplier, relative to the player's (Default: 1)
config.winefoxs_spellbooks.battle_walk_s: Movement speed multiplier for strafing and repositioning during spell combat.
config.winefoxs_spellbooks.max_combo_del: Maximum wait in ticks between two consecutive casts. Lower values make a maid chain spells more tightly.
config.winefoxs_spellbooks.drink_potion_: Unlimited healing potions in spell battle (Default: false)
A maid below 60% health drinks a healing potion without consuming an item, and can drink again as soon as the cooldown elapses — effectively unlimited sustain in combat.
config.winefoxs_spellbooks.show_chat_bub: Show spell names in spell battle (Default: true)
Shows the name of the spell a maid is casting in her chat bubble. Useful for spectating and troubleshooting.
config.winefoxs_spellbooks.melee_attack_: Allow maids to use melee weapons during spell attacks (Default: true)
When off, maids on the Magic Attack task only cast and never fall back to melee weapons.
config.winefoxs_spellbooks.air_force_bas: Base chance for air force maid (Default: 0.1)
Base chance for each summoned maid to ride a broom. Added to the per-level chance below.
config.winefoxs_spellbooks.air_force_cha: Extra flight chance added per level of the summoning spell, on top of the base chance.
config.winefoxs_spellbooks.air_force_fol: How far above its summoner a flying maid keeps station.
Horizontal radius at which a flying maid circles its summoner.
config.winefoxs_spellbooks.air_force_fly: Movement speed of a maid piloting a broom.
config.winefoxs_spellbooks.air_force_min: A flying maid keeps at least this far from its target, backing off before casting instead of hovering right on top of it.

Maid start casting range every spell id (override default)
Overrides the casting start distance per spell id. Defaults come from the datapack; entries here take priority. Requires a restart.
Settings for the Vulpine Anima that a max-favorability maid hands over when the player wakes.
Enable max-favorability maid morning gift (Default: true)
Master switch. When off, maids no longer gift at dawn; the other ways to obtain Vulpine Anima are unaffected.
Radius around the bed searched for an eligible gifting maid.
Require a normal full sleep cycle (Default: true)
When on, only a full night's sleep triggers the gift; when off, waking early because of monsters or thunder also counts.
Extra spell cause effect registry (spell id => effect id)
Declares which mob effect a spell applies, so maids can tell buffs from debuffs. Defaults come from the datapack. Requires a restart.
config.winefoxs_spellbooks.summoned_maid: Power caps for summoned maids, used to rein in what their randomly rolled loadouts can reach.
Highest spell level a summoned maid may carry (Default: 3)
Combined with the per-tier cap from the loadout datapack by taking the lower of the two — it can only reduce, never raise. Set to 10 to disable.
Highest spell rarity a summoned maid may carry (Default: EPIC)

Spells that exceed this rarity at every level are dropped from the pools entirely; the rest are levelled down until they fit. Filtering happens before rolling, so the number of spells a maid receives is unchanged. Set to LEGENDARY to disable.
Allow summoned maids to carry learned-only school spells, i.e. Eldritch (Default: false)
Learned-only schools — today, Eldritch — normally require a player to learn them first. Turning this on lets summoned maids roll them, bypassing that gate.
Creepers flee from summoned maids (Default: true)

Adds one AI goal to every creeper in the world. The goal costs nothing in dimensions with no summoned maid — it checks an O(1) counter before doing any entity search — so leaving this on is cheap. Turn it off to skip attaching the goal entirely.
config.winefoxs_spellbooks.lightning_man: Lightning-struck maids regenerate mana 100x faster (Default: false)
"Struck by lightning" is a permanent flag saved on the maid — once set it never wears off. With this on, such maids refill their whole mana bar every half second, which is effectively unlimited mana.
spell.winefoxs_spellbooks.summon_maid.gu: Summon mana-wielding maids to fight at your side for ten minutes. Higher levels call forth more maids.
spell.winefoxs_spellbooks.crescent_brand: Brands a single enemy with a crescent mark, leaving them vulnerable to further Winefox Hex interactions.
Brand a single enemy with a crescent mark. Any Winefox Hex damage detonates it, blasting nearby foes — detonations by your own maids hit harder and can chain.
spell.winefoxs_spellbooks.foxshade_wisps: Recast to loose one homing foxfire wisp per cast, up to 3. Each wisp flanks in and deals Winefox Hex damage, setting off any Crescent Brand it lands on.
Recast to loose homing foxfire wisps that flank your target from either side; every wisp deals Winefox Hex damage and detonates a Crescent Brand on impact.
spell.winefoxs_spellbooks.foxshade_ambus: Instant self-buff: coil for an ambush. The next time you deal damage to a foe, a foxshade appears nearby, dashes in and leaps to bite it once, then the effect fades.

Cast to coil for an ambush (10s). The next time you or your maid strikes a foe, a foxshade lands nearby, sprints to the target and leaps to bite it, dealing Winefox Hex damage and able to detonate a Crescent Brand — then the effect fades.
spell.winefoxs_spellbooks.crescent_mantl: Veil yourself and nearby owned maids in a crescent shroud: absorption hearts and brief invisibility to slip out of danger.
Veil yourself and your nearby maids in a crescent shroud, granting absorption and brief invisibility to slip out of danger.
spell.winefoxs_spellbooks.decant_the_bin: Pour off the dregs: harmful effects on you or a maid in your gaze are halved — or purged entirely at high vintage.
Pour off the dregs: shorten the harmful effects on yourself or an owned maid in your gaze — purged outright at full vintage.
spell.winefoxs_spellbooks.tipsy_mist.des: Roll out a plum-pink fog that keeps every creature inside it tipsy — your own maids stroll through unbothered.
spell.winefoxs_spellbooks.tipsy_mist.gui: Roll out a plum-pink fog that keeps creatures inside tipsy, staggering their steps and skewing their aim. Your own maids are unaffected.
Hurl a bottle of crescent vintage: it bursts into a wine pool that keeps foes tipsy while your maids soak up mana.
Hurl a bottle of crescent vintage that deals school damage on impact and bursts into a wine pool — foes soak up Tipsy while your maids soak up mana.

patchouli.touhou_little_maid.book.catego: Winefox's Spellbooks is an addon for Iron's Spells and Spellbooks, adding spellcasting tasks for maids
patchouli.touhou_little_maid.book.entrie: Mod Introduction

This is a crossover mod designed for Touhou Little Maid and Iron's Spells and Spellbooks, aiming to expand the magical combat capabilities of maids in Touhou Little Maid. By integrating with Iron's Spells and Spellbooks, maids can equip spellbooks as accessories and use various powerful magic attacks and summoning skills in battle.
Mana

Just like players, mana is the key to maid spellcasting. Different types and levels of spells require different amounts of mana to cast. Equipping staves and mage armor can increase the maximum mana cap.$(br)Maid mana regeneration rate is affected by mana regeneration attributes (not yet implemented). By default, it regenerates 2%% per second. Additionally, if a maid has been struck by lightning, the mana regeneration rate will be upgraded to 100%% every 0.5s.
Spellbook

Spellbooks are the medium for maid spellcasting. Maids cannot use spell scrolls to cast spells. Spellbooks must be equipped in the maid's accessory slot to take effect.$(br)In addition to regular spellbooks, weapons and equipment imbued with spells can also be used as casting media.
New Task Modes

This mod adds two new tasks for maids: Magic Attack and Magic Support.$(br)In Magic Attack mode, the maid will actively cast spells to attack hostile mobs. If she has a melee weapon and is close enough to the enemy, she will also use melee attacks.$(br)In Magic Support mode, the maid will not actively attack enemies, but instead try to heal nearby injured masters and allied creatures (including maids with the same master), or provide buffs to allies and debuffs to enemies.

Spells are classified into seven categories: Attack, Defense, Movement, Recovery, Positive Effect, Negative Effect, and Reinforcement. These can be configured via config files and datapacks. Built-in addon support: Cataclysm: Spellbooks, SnackPirate's Aeromancy Additions, Discerning The Eldritch, Ender's Spells and Stuff: Requiem, Fire's Ender Expansion, GTBC's Spellbooks, Magic From The East, Snow Waifu Spell, Hazen 'N Stuff, Dreamless Spells
Casting Animation

This mod adapts casting animations for GeckoLib maid models. Model pack authors can create an animation/<packname>.iss.animation.json file to implement custom animations. For reference on default animation key names, see this file: $(l:https://github.com/TartaricAcid/TouhouLittleMaid/blob/1.21/src/main/resources/assets/touhou_little_maid/animation/iss.animation.json)Click to open$(/l)
Winefox Hex School

$(bold)Winefox Hex$() is the new spell school added by this mod, covering summoning, support, and mana manipulation.$(br)The school is resolved by its own $(thing)spell power$() and $(thing)magic resist$() attributes, and can be stacked with mage gear bonuses from Iron's Spells itself.
Vulpine Anima

The school's Focus — a lively wisp of foxfire coils within the glass orb.$(br)At the $(thing)Scroll Forge$() it serves as the crafting ingredient for this school's spell scrolls, and it doubles as a casting implement for higher-tier spells.$(br)Obtained from: fairies killed by maids, themed chest loot, or a morning gift from a maid at max favorability.

Spells currently in this school:$(br)$(li)$(item)Mana Transfer$()$(li)$(item)Summon Maid$()$(li)$(item)Crescent Brand$()$(li)$(item)Foxshade Wisps$()$(li)$(item)Crescent Mantle$()$(li)$(item)Decant the Bind$()$(li)$(item)Tipsy Mist$()$(li)$(item)Vintner's Bomb$()$(br)See each spell's own entry in this category for details.

$(bold)Brewsurge$() is the school's shared buff: every time a $(item)Crescent Brand$() is detonated — by you or by your own maid — the commander stacks one level (rolling 10-second refresh, up to 3 stacks), each granting +10%% Winefox Hex spell power.$(br)At full stacks, your maids' brand detonations also gain a larger radius — chain the detonations to keep the wine surging.
Mana Transfer

$(bold)Mana Transfer$() is a continuous Winefox Hex spell, lasting up to 5 seconds and channelling the caster's mana to the aimed target.$(br)The target must be a $(thing)player$() or an entity with a mana pool (such as this mod's maids). About 20%% is lost in transit, and higher spell levels deliver more mana per second.$(br)Maids on the $(thing)Magic Support$() task will also cast this on allies whose mana is low.
Crescent Brand

$(bold)Crescent Brand$() is where the detonation loop begins: a ray-cast marks a single target up to 16 blocks away with a $(thing)Crescent Brand$() (12 seconds, +1s per level). The brand itself deals no damage — it is a fuse waiting to be lit.

While branded, the moment the target takes any $(thing)Winefox Hex damage$(), the brand detonates into a school AoE burst around it; burst damage = a base of 6 plus the spell power at branding time (growing with vintage and bouquet).$(br)Detonated by a $(thing)player$(): radius 3, no chaining. Detonated by $(thing)your own maid$(): ×1.5 damage, radius 4 (5 at full Brewsurge on the owner), and the burst can chain-detonate the next branded target. Every detonation also stacks one level of $(thing)Brewsurge$() on the commander.$(br)A brand that expires naturally only weakly self-detonates within 2 blocks (no Brewsurge).
Foxshade Wisps

$(bold)Foxshade Wisps$() is a recast spell: the first cast pays the mana, then each further press looses one homing wisp, up to 3 in total; letting 4 seconds lapse ends the volley into cooldown.$(br)Each wisp locks onto a hostile target within 16 blocks and flanks in from the side, dealing Winefox Hex damage.

All three wisps are identical — there is no finisher shot. Their damage counts as Winefox Hex, so whichever wisp lands on a target carrying a $(item)Crescent Brand$() sets the brand off.$(br)Maids on the $(thing)Magic Attack$() task chain the recasts automatically.
Crescent Mantle

$(bold)Crescent Mantle$() is the emergency exit: it veils you and every owned maid within 6 blocks in $(thing)Absorption$() (base 4 seconds, upgraded to Absorption III from level 6) plus $(thing)True Invisibility$() (base 3 seconds — gear vanishes too and mobs lose aggro); both durations gain +0.5s per level.$(br)When focused down, mantle up, slip away, then decide whether to counterattack or retreat.
Decant the Bind

$(bold)Decant the Bind$() is the school's cleanse: it targets yourself, or an owned maid in your gaze within 16 blocks.$(br)On cast, every harmful effect on the target has its remaining duration halved; at max level (5) they are purged outright instead.
Tipsy Mist

$(bold)Tipsy Mist$() rolls out a plum-pink fog, 5 blocks in radius, at the aimed spot (up to 24 blocks away), lasting 6 seconds plus 0.5s per level. Creatures inside are repeatedly doused with $(thing)Tipsy$(); your own maids stroll through unbothered. From spell level 5 it applies Tipsy II.

$(thing)Tipsy$() deals no damage, but it slows movement by 30%%, makes victims stagger and wander, and badly deflects any arrows or projectiles they loose.$(br)Players are equally slowed and have their shots deflected. Tipsy II doubles the slow and the stagger.
Vintner's Bomb

$(bold)Vintner's Bomb$() hurls a bottle of crescent vintage: a direct hit deals Winefox Hex damage, and the impact spreads a $(thing)wine pool$() 2.5 blocks in radius that lasts 5 seconds.$(br)Foes soaking in the pool are kept Tipsy; your own maids soak up mana instead (about 5%% of max mana per second).
Summon Maid

Summon Maid is a Winefox Hex school spell that summons temporary maid combat units. Summoned maids randomly receive models, equipment, and spells, and automatically perform attack or support tasks.$(br)Maids come in three loadouts: Warrior, Mage, and Support, each with different equipment and spell combinations. Higher spell levels summon more maids with stronger equipment and spells.$(br)Maids have a chance to ride brooms for aerial combat, circling around targets while casting spells.$(br)Duration is 10 minutes. You can also use the /wsb summon command to customize summoning.
Custom Loadout Datapacks

Summoned maid loadouts are fully datapack-driven, located at data/<namespace>/summoned_maid_loadouts/<name>.json.$(br)Each loadout file can define weight, model filter, broom mode, and tiered equipment and spell pools based on summon level.$(br)Weapons and armor are referenced via item tags, spells via spell tags, all supporting weighted randomization and roll count ranges.$(br)See the default loadout files warrior.json, mage.json, and support.json for reference.
Channel your mana into the aimed player or maid, losing a little in transit.
